researchPlan.objective: Identify and extract active frontend engineering job openings at Indian software companies from public career portals and applicant tracking systems.
researchPlan.title: Active Frontend Engineering Roles in India

outputFields.name: company_name
outputFields.description: The name of the hiring company
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for company branding or header text

outputFields.name: job_title
outputFields.description: The specific title of the frontend role
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for H1 tags or job header elements

outputFields.name: job_url
outputFields.description: Direct link to the job application page
outputFields.extractionHint: Extract href from apply button or job listing link

outputFields.name: location
outputFields.description: The city or remote status of the role
outputFields.validationHint: Must indicate India-based location or remote
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for location metadata or text near job title

outputFields.name: posted_date
outputFields.description: The date the job was posted
outputFields.validationHint: Must be a valid date format
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for 'Posted X days ago' or date stamps

searchQueries: "frontend engineer" hiring India software company career
researchPlan.sourceStrategy: Prioritize open Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and official company career pages to ensure direct, verifiable job links without requiring social media logins.

validationRules.rule: Must be located in India or explicitly remote
